title: Bram and the Echo
author: Emrys Amberdale
blurb: Oscar Crane, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
